description: The status-check contexts the master ruleset must require. ruleset-integrity.yml diffs this list against the live ruleset weekly: a context MISSING from the live ruleset fails the check (a gate silently stopped blocking), while an EXTRA context only warns (a deliberately added gate — update this list to ratify it). Keep in sync when required checks are added or renamed. Bootstrapped from the live ruleset on 2026-08-26.
